name: Worldforged Old Insignia stands on the Crusader Outpost floor, Tirisfal Glades (#9185)
contract: Pickup template 515377 (item 515020 Scarlet Insignia, guid 6941016) is the only Tirisfal copy left after #8904. A later LootCollector-alignment pass overwrote its 2026-09-26 in-game audited spot with a terrain-level position about 4.4 yd below the Crusader Outpost floor the player walks (Captain Perrine and Scarlet Neophyte both stand near z 49.09, 5 yd away). Restore the audited spot (1803.41, 727.664, 49.4158), guarded on the current LootCollector-alignment coordinates so a newer correction is never overwritten. The outpost floor is a WMO platform, not a vmap-recognized ground model there (confirmed: the harness reads the open terrain underneath, +5.44 yd below the restored spot), so the gap check below only tells the restored height apart from the sunken one, not the exact floor.
